texts.name: Mollur
texts.biography: Mollur is one of the oldest Jotunn of his clan, his prowess in battle and his courage are known throughout Vori. He only has to give a war cry for all the Jotunn to follow him into battle, without asking a single question.

specialty.name: Jotunn
specialty.description: Increases the Speed of allied Jotuuns and Jotunn Warlords by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
